title: fix(gateway): distinguish probe timeout under load
body:
## Summary

- classify an admitted status RPC timeout separately from an unreachable Gateway
- preserve hello-snapshot event-loop evidence when the read RPC times out
- render event-loop saturation metrics instead of a generic connectivity failure

## Verification

- `pnpm vitest run src/cli/daemon-cli/probe.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/status.print.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/status.print.timeout.test.ts` (86 passed, 1 platform skip)
- `pnpm check:changed`

The changed-file gate initially caught growth in a grandfathered over-cap test file. The new rendering scenario now lives in a focused sibling test and the line-cap ratchet passes.
